title: Late Payment Finance Charge Rates — Commercial Credit Account Tariff
content:
Late payment finance charges on a Commercial Credit Account are assessed at the rates of the account's terms tier.

| | Net 10 Starter | Net 30 Standard | Net 30 Preferred | Net 45 Business | Net 60 Corporate | Net 90 Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly rate, percent of the eligible past-due balance | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.25 | 1 | 1 |
| Grace days past the due date | 0 | 5 | 5 | 10 | 15 | 15 |
| Minimum charge, USD | 5.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 | 2.50 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Eligible balance below which no charge is assessed, USD | 50.00 | 50.00 | 100.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 |
| Unpaid finance charges accrue finance charges | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Courtesy reversals the desk may grant in a rolling 12 months | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 |

### Tariff notes

1. The monthly rate is the late payment finance charge, percent per month of the eligible past-due balance.
2. Grace days are the days past the due date before an invoice balance becomes eligible for the finance charge.
3. The minimum charge applies when a charge applies; 0.00 means the computed amount stands.
4. The waiver balance is the eligible past-due balance below which no finance charge is assessed for the month.
5. Compounding is "no" for every tier: unpaid finance charges do not themselves accrue finance charges.
6. Courtesy reversals are the number of finance charges the desk may reverse as a courtesy within a rolling 12 months.

### Reading across the tariff

- The Corbett Net 10 Starter Account has no grace days and no courtesy reversals.
- The Corbett Net 60 Corporate and Net 90 Strategic tiers carry a minimum of 0.00, so their computed charge stands as computed.
